instruction: A candid documentary medium-full shot from behind captures an indoor studio with a red carpeted floor, white walls, and an office printer visible in the background. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, reaching out with his right hand to touch the right shoulder of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the right, facing away from the camera. The room is lit by warm overhead lights.

R2 receives the shoulder touch from R1 rather than touching R1
R1 initiates contact while R2 faces away from the camera
